messages:
morgan: Quick kickoff — we need to align on scope for the visibility sprint. Main asks: dashboards (per-model, per-route cost), low-overhead tracing hooks, and error analytics. Customers: two enterprise pilots + platform teams. Need launch criteria and which parts we cut.

alejandra: Agree. Tracing hooks are highest risk for perf. Proposal: low_overhead default (trace-only metadata, no spans) + opt-in full spans for canaries.

mike: SRE note: define SLOs and max p99 CPU impact. Also need sampling defaults. +1 to opt-in full spans.

sasha: Cost side: embeddings/rerank inflates metrics. We should show per-token and per-embedding rows and attribution to model variant.

jordan: Customer asks: per-route cost heatmap and ability to pin rollout to dedicated capacity. Also want error cohorts by prompt set.

kevin: UX: quick toggle for tracing mode, and a 'cost drilldown' flyout from the dashboard.

liz: Ops question—can we gate trace rollout by region and config? Need canary % and auto rollback policy.

sasha: Draft sampling config:
```yaml
trace_hook:
  mode: low_overhead
  sampling:
    default: 0.001  # 0.1%
    enterprise_override: 0.01
  adaptive: true
```
Acceptance criteria (MVP):
- dashboards show per-route token and embedding cost
- tracing hooks can be enabled in low_overhead with sampling <=0.1%
- error analytics surface top 5 prompt cohorts and stack traces sampled
- rollout can be limited by region and customer tag

morgan: Proposed launch cuts: shipping dashboards + low-overhead tracing + basic error cohorts. Defer deep trace spans and advanced analytics to v1.1. Bake time: 2 weeks on canary, 2 weeks general.

alejandra: Fine, but we must instrument KV cache + batching metrics before launch so cost numbers are accurate.

mike: Adaptive sampling is important — if error rate spikes, increase trace sampling to 5% for affected route.

kevin: I'll mock the flyout and share screens tomorrow.

deploy-bot: new meeting scheduled: #observe-ship-review — 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC

morgan: Next steps:
- engineering: finalize trace hook perf budget (alejandra + liz)
- product: refine launch criteria and customer comms (jordan + morgan)
- devex: quick toggle + flyout mock (kevin)
We'll sync in the review on 3/25. Thanks :thumbsup:
